blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No player won the jackpots in the Ultra Lotto 6/58, Super Lotto 6/49 and Lotto 6/42 draws Tuesday, Oct. 6, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Ultra Lotto 6/58 winning combination was 26-18-44-43-49-57 for a jackpot of ₱368.81 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Super Lotto 6/49 draw produced the combination 38-10-03-39-07-13 for a jackpot of ₱37.05 million. There was no jackpot winner.
